aggregation.cost: Sum of reported-token costs at the frozen rates for both response orders within each family; USD, not invoice reconciliation.
aggregation.quality: Mean delivered fraction of retained human votes matched, averaged over both response orders within each family. Attempted abstentions, errors and invalid outputs receive zero.

scope: These derived numerical aggregates reproduce the paired statistics and economics. They do not expose response choices, raw human votes, conversation text, provider request identifiers or machine paths, and cannot independently verify the underlying annotation or provider responses.
study: Everval judge cost and quality confirmation, 2026-10-27
